items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps oily-feeling skin fresh without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's moisture barrier without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 is the one habit that does the most to keep skin looking its best over the years.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, moisturize, and apply the SPF every morning, reapplying if you are outdoors for long. At 15 your skin does not need vitamin C or a firming cream, so I left them out and kept the routine short enough to stick with.
